title: Crispy Street-Style Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 1 tbsp chili powder, 1.5 tsp cumin, 1.5 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp salt
Juice of 1 lime + 2 tbsp orange juice
1/2 white onion, finely diced & 1/2 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped
Salsa verde or roasted red salsa, queso fresco, and lime wedges
instructions: Marinate chicken thighs in oil, lime juice, orange juice, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, oregano, and salt for at least 20 minutes.
Sear the chicken thighs in a hot cast-iron skillet or on a grill for 5–6 minutes per side until deeply charred and juicy (175°F internal).
Rest 5 minutes, then chop finely into street-taco bite-sized pieces, tossing back in the pan juices.
Dip corn tortillas lightly in the pan drippings, char on the hot skillet, and fill with chopped chicken, finely diced white onion, cilantro, and salsa.
